risk_note: F1-10kc (orchestrator D10-1341 / D10-1347). In the admin AI assistant record trace drawer (F1-10ka) a message whose text is null now shows the neutral placeholder （无文本） instead of claiming the text was cleared by account deletion, since an empty text may also be an unfinished reply or one closed after a crash. The deletion note appears only when the session's user_id is null and is worded conditionally (若账号已注销，文本已按规定清除；…), because a null user_id is also a guest session (BR-AI-20; BR-AI-22 for deletion); sessions with a user_id never show 注销. Two files under apps/admin/src/pages/agent-traces and texts/agent-traces.ts. Rule tests by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh); tsc -b test 0 errors before commit; Codex spec-test r1 pass; red on couli-ci (3 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5: couli-ci fast run 2 green (the new tests and every frozen admin-agent-traces test), run.ts static 10/10. Codex money review r1 pass, no findings. Written by hand.
